notes.title: WestFallen Launches Into Early Access!
notes.content:
Before we begin, here is the cinematic trailer for WestFallen Early Access!

[previewyoutube=MzzZQL-wyGk;full][/previewyoutube]

Go ahead and subscribe there to stay up to date with the devlogs, trailers, and other videos that we do about the world of indie games!

As well, here is a shameless plug for our [url=discord.gg/vJpGPAyv9q]Discord! [/url]

[h2]Release Date...Sorta[/h2]
The plan is to launch the game as soon as possible, hopefully sometime either on the 12th of December, or sometime in that week, seeing as the game is fully ready to launch, minus the final approval from Steam. All that is left is to remove the partial controller support check box, since that feature does not yet feel consistent with the gameplay as of now.

[h2]What is Coming Next[/h2]
So you might remember in a previous announcement a roadmap to the release of the arena/early access.
From that roadmap, all that is really left is to improve some of the voiceover work. Some of it does not capture the feel, but that is a minor tweak that should not take more than an afternoon while waiting for the final greenlight from Steam.

Along with the release will be another announcement regarding the early access vs final vision for the game, and what to expect, likely in the form of a summary of a YouTube video that is in the works.

[h2]Final Comments[/h2]
Thank you to everyone who wishlisted, we are up to almost 350, which for us is well above what we expected, seeing that motivates the work on the game, so thanks again, and we hope that you guys all enjoy the game.

In the coming while, we will be releasing concept art, prototype gameplay of the open world segment, and turning some of the features seen in the early access into fully fledged systems that stand on their own, so stay tuned, as on the second Sunday of every month there will be a small announcement detailing the work done, so you guys can stay up to date.

Cheers!

~The team at Ninja Software Studio

notes.title: State of WestFallen - 10/9/2022
notes.content:
[h1]Hey all![/h1]

So, the last announcement posted had a roadmap that listed several things that had to be done before the arena could be launched. Both fortunately and unfortunately, there has been a big change to that.

[h2]First some positive news![/h2]
I have been very busy creating new enemies, and finding ways to make them exciting and fun. Since this early access portion is mostly just a horde mode, I have been able to have a lot of freedom with the kinds of enemies I create. Below are some images of a few of the enemies you will face in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339984/040101eab278a97ca356cbe0155ffb8d68f94120.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339984/6a4ebd2de2e02bf9bb9c3f1fd3885a768aaf7e1f.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339984/13cff0bb2e25f62b0191d0a83345685ed75bd866.png[/img]

As well, the enemies all have something that differentiates them from the other ones, giving you a unique challenge depending on the mix of them in front of you.

Secondly, work has been progressing well on the redesign of the arena map. While currently I do not have anything really worth showing, the redesign is adding some new elements and features to the map that originally were not there, such as elevation changes, area traps, as well as some secrets and some hidden Easter eggs that I hope you find.

[h2]So what's changed?[/h2]

tldr; I have changed my approach to how combat works in the game, causing a delay.

While testing out the game, the main issue I found was that arose was that the gameplay was very monotone. The combo system showcased on Instagram was not the most exciting after some time with it, and dodging the witch spell was also hard with the movement system I had. To change that, I added some abilities that made the game more exciting and much more fun. However, this introduced a lot of bugs into the game. And despite numerous attempts, the final method to fix this, which works much better is to use Unreal Engine's Gameplay Ability System (GAS). However, that means that I won't be releasing the game as soon as I had hoped, leading to a delay in progress.

[h2]What does that mean?[/h2]
In the end, what this means is that this coming week is going to be spent reworking the combat so that instead of using the previous method of combat interaction, I will now be using the GAS framework, which requires a far more involved approach.

Hopefully, this only adds an extra week or so, but only time will tell. 

In the meantime, make sure to stay up to date by following the progress on Instagram [url=https://www.instagram.com/ninjasoftwarestudio/]here[/url], as well as on this page, where I will post updates every other week.

See you all next week!

~Ninja Software Studio
